test_cases.name: OCR poll via CMD1 until busy clears, then CMD2/CMD3 assign RCA (idle->ready->ident->stby).
SEND_EXT_CSD (CMD8) returns 512 bytes; SWITCH (CMD6) updates a single EXT_CSD field.
Switch BUS_WIDTH to 8-bit DDR and verify block read/write.
PARTITION_CONFIG switch to Boot1 / RPMB / GPP and verify access isolation.
Alternative boot (CMD0 arg 0xFFFFFFFA) streams boot-partition contents.
Authenticated RPMB write/read with HMAC-SHA256 + write counter; replay attempt rejected.
HS200 tuning then HS400 DDR with Data Strobe at 400 MB/s; verify read-data integrity.
Enqueue >1 task (CMD44/45), execute out-of-order (CMD46/47), verify Queue Status.
TRIM/Discard then Sanitize; verify purged data unreadable. FFU updates firmware (FFU_STATUS ok).
